transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me. As you know, we're reviewing the proposed eighth-grade makerspace program before I make a final authorization decision. The program would involve 24 students meeting twice weekly during the spring semester, using soldering stations, hand tools, and a laser cutter, with one STEM teacher supervising. I'd like to hear from each of you on the implementation details relevant to your areas of expertise so I can make an informed decision. Let's start with the STEM teacher — could you walk us through the staffing and supervision plan?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thank you, Dr. Morgan. Before I walk through the plan, I need to flag an important safety issue. I completed a room-safety review this week, and it found that the makerspace may enroll no more than 16 students. Additionally, any session using soldering stations with more than 12 students requires two supervising adults. The draft program form still shows the original numbers — 24 students with one STEM teacher — so those will need to be revised before this program can be safely authorized.

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to share a health-record finding that hasn't yet been added to the program file. My review of the participating students' health records identified one student with a documented severe nickel allergy. That student may participate only when the program uses nickel-free components, and I must approve the materials list before each session. This review has not yet been added to the program file, so the rest of the team may not be aware of this constraint.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to flag a technology compliance issue. I confirmed with the district technology office that student design files for this equipment may not use cloud storage. The approved workflow is an offline design workstation with files transferred by encrypted USB after an IT malware scan. However, the draft program still specifies cloud-based computer-aided design files, and I have not yet updated the draft to reflect the required offline workflow. This will need to be corrected before authorization.
